title: Show HN: Academa – Long-form STEM lecture videos generated by LLMs
text:
Hi HN, we are Sina Atalay and Abdullah Geduk, co-founders of Academa. We are both PhD students.

We thought: what if lecture videos were written as code and compiled into video using computer graphics and TTS?

Then LLMs could write them, and lectures could be fixed with code edits instead of video production.

On correctness: LLMs may make mistakes. But these videos are code sitting in our repository, and we can maintain them. Every report and review becomes a fix in the source, and everyone who watches after that gets the corrected lecture. Every recorded lecture on the internet is stuck with its mistakes. Ours will continuously improve.

Each video also comes with an AI chat that understands everything said and shown in the lecture.

There is a longer write-up at the bottom of the page.

Happy to answer any questions.
summary: 这个帖子介绍了一个名为Academa的项目，它利用LLM生成代码，再通过计算机图形和TTS编译成STEM长视频讲座，亮点在于讲座可以像代码一样被维护和修正。

title: Continuous Diffusion Language Models (CDLM's)
summary: 该帖介绍了一种新型连续扩散语言模型（CDLM），通过连续空间中的扩散过程替代传统离散token生成，有望提升文本生成的流畅性和可控性。看点在于其理论创新与潜在性能优势，可能为语言建模开辟新方向。

title: Zig: Pointer Stability for ArrayLists
summary: Zig 官方开发日志提出为 ArrayList 引入指针稳定性保证，避免扩容时元素地址失效。看点在于这一设计权衡了内存效率与 API 安全性，对系统编程实践有直接影响。

title: Claude Session URL appended to commit messages and PR descriptions by default
summary: 该帖子讨论Claude Code默认将会话URL附加到提交信息和PR描述中的问题，引发用户对隐私和仓库元数据污染的争议。

title: Benchmarking Pocket-Scale Inference
summary: 该帖评测了手机等小型设备上的AI推理性能，对比不同芯片和模型的运行速度与效率，看点在于揭示移动端本地运行大模型的现实瓶颈与潜力。

title: Hy4 preview
summary: 腾讯发布并开源了Hy4预览版，这是一个新的AI模型，看点在于其技术细节和开源策略对行业的影响。

title: Functional State Machines in Rust: Typestate and Newtype Patterns
summary: 这篇帖子介绍了一篇关于在Rust中利用Typestate和Newtype模式实现函数式状态机的学术论文，看点在于如何通过类型系统在编译期强制状态转换的合法性，从而消除运行时错误。

title: Show HN: Hillock: Local neuro-symbolic memory engine in <1.2GB VRAM
summary: Hillock 是一个可在不到1.2GB显存中运行的本地神经符号记忆引擎，结合了神经网络与符号推理，适合资源受限环境下的AI记忆管理。
